nodes.description: Constant number of seconds per day (86400) used for all release math.
Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock.
Immutable beneficiary address receiving released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp of the vesting period, rounded down to a day boundary.
Mutable end timestamp of the release period, shortened on terminate.
Total benefit amount still subject to vesting, reduced on terminate.
Cumulative amount the beneficiary has already withdrawn.
Flag marking the contract as terminated so no further terminate call is possible.
Address of the contract owner used for access control.
Initializes token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit; validates end time against block.timestamp.
Modifier requiring the contract not to be terminated.
View returning the held token address.
View returning the beneficiary address.
View returning the total benefit amount.
Computes the currently released amount using block.timestamp, day arithmetic and proportional scaling.
Returns totalBenefit minus releasedBalance.
View returning the already withdrawn balance.
Transfers the newly released benefit to the beneficiary after updating internal accounting.
Owner-only: shortens the release window, locks the released amount and refunds residual tokens to the owner.
Modifier restricting execution to the current owner.
View returning the owner address.
Internal setter writing the owner address and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Owner-only transfer of ownership to a non-zero address.
Owner-only renouncement setting owner to address(0).
Internal helper returning msg.sender.
Library wrapper performing an ERC20 transfer with return-value checking.
Low-level token call checking optional boolean return data.
Performs a low-level call that requires the target to be a contract.
Performs a value-bearing low-level call after balance and contract checks.
Forwards wei with a low-level call, forwarding all available gas.
Checks whether an address holds contract code via extcodesize.
Performs a staticcall against a contract target.
Performs a delegatecall against a contract target.
Caller-controlled address used by _msgSender and owner checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving vesting, released balance and termination.
Origin address available to the EVM; not referenced by this contract's logic.
Arithmetic rounding: releaseStartTime_ -= (releaseStartTime_ % SECONDS_OF_A_DAY).
Arithmetic multiplication: daysOfTimelock_ * SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Arithmetic division of elapsed seconds by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY, dependent on block.timestamp.
Arithmetic division of the release window by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Arithmetic scaling: (_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays.
Arithmetic subtraction: _totalBenefit - releasedBalance().
Arithmetic subtraction: releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
Arithmetic accumulation: _withdrawedBalance += amount before the token transfer.
Arithmetic: block.timestamp - (block.timestamp % SECONDS_OF_A_DAY), miner-influenceable timestamp truncation.
Arithmetic: token balanceOf(this) - (_totalBenefit - _withdrawedBalance).
External call token().safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) in withdraw().
External call token().safeTransfer(owner(), amountToWithdraw) in terminate().
External call recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwarding arbitrary code execution.
External call target.call{value: value}(data) with attacker-influenced data.
External call target.staticcall(data) to an arbitrary target.
External call target.delegatecall(data) executing untrusted code in this contract's context.
Inline assembly extcodesize(account) used for contract detection.
Constructor parameter: the ERC20 token to hold.
Constructor parameter: beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter: release start timestamp, rounded down to a day.
Constructor parameter: number of days of the vesting period.
Constructor parameter: total benefit amount subject to vesting.
Local in releasedBalance holding elapsed full days.
Local in releasedBalance holding the total number of vesting days.
Local in withdraw holding the newly released amount.
Local in terminate holding the residual token amount refunded to the owner.
Parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership: the new owner address.
Parameter of Ownable._setOwner: address written to _owner.
Local in Ownable._setOwner caching the previous owner for the event.
Parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer: token contract.
Parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer: recipient.
Parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer: amount of tokens.
Parameter of SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn: target token.
Parameter of SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn: encoded calldata.
Local in SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn holding the raw return data.
Parameter of Address.functionCallWithValue: call target.
Parameter of Address.functionCallWithValue: calldata payload.
Parameter of Address.functionCallWithValue: wei forwarded.
Parameter of Address.functionCallWithValue: revert message.
Local capturing the success flag of the low-level call.
Local capturing the raw return data of the low-level call.
Parameter of Address.sendValue: payable recipient.
Parameter of Address.sendValue: wei amount.
Parameter of Address.isContract: address whose code size is inspected.
Local in Address.isContract holding extcodesize result.
Parameter of Address.functionStaticCall: staticcall target.
Parameter of Address.functionStaticCall: calldata payload.
Parameter of Address.functionStaticCall: revert message.
Parameter of Address.functionDelegateCall: delegatecall target.
Parameter of Address.functionDelegateCall: calldata payload.
Parameter of Address.functionDelegateCall: revert message.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to immutable state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to _beneficiary.
releaseStartTime_ is consumed by the modulo rounding arithmetic.
Day-rounded release start time is written to _releaseStartTime.

daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is the multiplier in the duration computation.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is used in the modulo rounding of the start time.
Vesting duration feeds the computation of _releaseEndTime.
releaseStartTime_ is added to the duration to derive _releaseEndTime.
totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, a timestamp-dependent check.
Ownable constructor invokes _msgSender() to initialize ownership.
Constructor execution reaches _setOwner.
_msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against owner().
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_setOwner writes the new owner address into _owner.
Previous _owner is cached into the oldOwner local for the event.
transferOwnership forwards newOwner into _setOwner.

transferOwnership calls _setOwner with the validated address.

isNotTerminated reads the _isTerminated flag.
releasedBalance branches on block.timestamp versus the release window.
Elapsed-days computation depends on block.timestamp.
_releaseStartTime is subtracted from block.timestamp.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY divides the elapsed seconds.
Result of the elapsed-day division is stored in passedDays.
_releaseEndTime participates in the total-days computation.
_releaseStartTime participates in the total-days computation.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY divides the release window.
Result of the window division is stored in totalDays.
passedDays is a factor of the proportional benefit computation.
totalDays is the denominator of the proportional benefit computation.
_totalBenefit is scaled by passed days/total days.
Computed proportional amount is returned by releasedBalance.
Entire _totalBenefit is returned once the release period has elapsed.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance.
releasedBalance result is subtracted from the total benefit.
_totalBenefit is the minuend of the unreleased computation.
Unreleased amount is returned by unreleasedBalance.

releasedBalance is the minuend when computing the withdrawable delta.
_withdrawedBalance is subtracted from the released balance.

amount is accumulated into _withdrawedBalance.
_withdrawedBalance is read and updated in place.
